comments.author: @russellmingus2590
comments.text:
It's the biggest small town. Among anyone who has been here for more than 5 years or so , the degree of separation seems to be only about 2-3.

I've also found that Tacoma isn't as unknown as we think it probably is around the US. And I've been surprised around the the world as well. With JBLM, many, many people have been here, or have family who were stationed here.  
It's not always a good reputation. Some of that we've earned. Some is Seattlite slander. The rest, yes, it's awful, definitely don't move here.
The only thing I really feel compelled to defend, is the Aroma of Tacoma. It was taken care of probably 20 years ago.
